stem: What was one result of the law described above?

options.label: F
options.text: Northerners who believed the law was unfair began to support the abolitionist movement.

options.label: G
options.text: Religious groups left the abolitionist movement to avoid political controversy.

options.label: H
options.text: Southerners used the law to challenge the constitutionality of abolitionist goals.

options.label: J
options.text: Abolitionist societies began to focus their efforts on promoting women’s suffrage.

visual_elements: This controversial law allowed slave-hunters to seize alleged fugitive slaves without due process of law and prohibited anyone from aiding escaped fugitives or obstructing their recovery. Because it was often presumed that a black person was a slave, the law threatened the safety of all blacks. . . .
—Text from an online exhibit describing the Fugitive Slave Law of 1850, Library of Congress, http://www.loc.gov (accessed December 9, 2009)
